ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: spellsinger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Spellsingers weave magic into music. A war chant makes soldiers fearless, a lullaby drops raiders where they stand, and a good tune keeps the whole colony smiling.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Music is magic. Inspire allies, enthrall enemies, and keep the colony happy.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Why does the colony keep a bard?' 'Have you seen our mood numbers?'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The ultimate support with fantastic quality-of-life utility. Buff allies, put enemies to sleep, and keep moods high between fights. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: skald
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Skalds sing on the battlefield, and their songs shake the ground. Their allies fight like heroes; their enemies hear their own dirge.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Battle hymns and thunder chords. A war bard who leads from the front.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The skald's songs are long. The battles he sings about were short.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Front-line support. Keep Battle Hymn up, stun with Thunderous Chord, and drop the Song of Ragnarok on the big fights. Wants Attunement and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: illusionist
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Illusionists weave lies so beautiful the world believes them. Enemies fight for them, guards sleep, and prisoners suddenly decide to join.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Charm, mesmerize and deceive. Turn enemies into friends - temporarily or permanently.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'He's been a pirate for twenty years.' 'And now?' 'Now he's our cook.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Mind control and recruitment. Charm the most dangerous enemy, Mesmerize the rest, and Silver Tongue your prisoners into colonists. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: jester
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Jesters treat magic as a joke, and the joke is usually on the enemy. Their spells are random, ridiculous and frequently devastating.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Chaos magic, custard pies and terrible luck - for your enemies, mostly.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Nobody hired the jester. Nobody can remember when he arrived. Nobody can make him leave.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Embrace randomness. Wild Magic and Grand Finale can do anything, Lucky Coin makes allies crit, and the pies never stop. Wants Attunement and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: showman
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everyone likes a good performer. Better at talking, trading and charming.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: muse
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Simply being around you is entertaining. Nearby colonists slowly regain recreation.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: requiem
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your music becomes a weapon: sonic magic hits much harder and resonates through machines.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grand symphony
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your songs carry further and linger far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living legend
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Songs are already being sung about you. Allies nearby in combat always have valor.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: nightsong
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You hum in your sleep, and everyone sleeps better for it. Every hour, everyone within 9 cells of you (drafted or not, prisoners and animals too) rests 20% faster for the next hour. Put your bed in the barracks.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: einherjar
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The song is not over. When downed, rise again in a thunderous chord. Once per day.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: war band
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your warband never stops fighting: allies nearby always have valor and a trickle of ward.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: frith
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Where the skald sits, there is peace. Every hour, everyone within 10 cells of you (drafted or not) is under frith for the next hour: no social fights start, and their mental break threshold is 4% lower.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: doppelganger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: An illusion takes the hit; you were never there.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: puppeteer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Attackers may be charmed into changing sides mid-swing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: mastermind
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your illusions reach further and hold far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: enthrall
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Enemies who come close to you periodically freeze, transfixed.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bakery
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Throw one more pie per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: trickster
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Sometimes your spells come with a bonus round of Wild Magic.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: hijinks
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Banana peel? Trapdoor? Who knows. You simply aren't where the attack lands.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the house always wins
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Luck is a skill. Huge crit chance and spells often refund themselves.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pandemonium
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Chaos follows you everywhere: Wild Magic erupts around a random enemy every five seconds in combat.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: class clown
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You can't help being funny. Every hour, each person within 8 cells of you (drafted or not) has one chance in six to crack up at something you did: +4 mood for six hours.

AbilityDef.label: discordant note
AbilityDef.description: A note so sour it hurts. May leave the target dazed.

AbilityDef.label: song of rest
AbilityDef.description: A gentle melody: allies nearby heal a little and feel rested.

AbilityDef.label: war chant
AbilityDef.description: A thunderous war chant: allies nearby fight braver, harder and steadier.

AbilityDef.label: lullaby
AbilityDef.description: A soft, irresistible lullaby. Enemies in the area fall asleep where they stand.

AbilityDef.label: inspire
AbilityDef.description: Sing a colonist a song made just for them. They gain a random inspiration.

AbilityDef.label: joyful tune
AbilityDef.description: Play a cheerful tune for everyone nearby. Recreation is restored and spirits soar.

AbilityDef.label: sonic boom
AbilityDef.description: Release a deafening blast of sound in front of you.

AbilityDef.label: ballad of heroes
AbilityDef.description: The song of legends. Every ally nearby gains valor, steadiness and a strong ward.

AbilityDef.label: siren's call
AbilityDef.description: Sing a note no one can resist. Enemies in the area stumble toward its center, entranced, and stand there listening.

AbilityDef.label: standing ovation
AbilityDef.description: Give the performance of a lifetime. Every colonist who hears it is struck by inspiration.

AbilityDef.label: echoing notes
AbilityDef.description: Sing five notes that take wing and chase enemies down, ringing in their skulls.

AbilityDef.label: revelry
AbilityDef.description: Strike up a dance tune and call the colony to a party. A real party gathers around you at a party spot, table or campfire (attending lifts the mood as any good party does), and everyone within 12 cells of you is festive for four hours: their recreation fills 50% faster. Needs a free gathering spot and a colony that is not busy fighting; the festive mood lands even if the party cannot start. Once every two days.

li.flavor: Somebody has to start the dancing.

AbilityDef.label: fireside sing-along
AbilityDef.description: Lead everyone within 7 cells in a song they all know. Up to 10 people who are awake (colonists, slaves, prisoners and guests alike, children too) sing together: every pair of them gains +10 opinion of each other for six days, each regains 15% recreation, and the bigger the choir the better they all feel for a day (+3 mood for two or three voices, +5 for four, +7 for six, +9 for eight or more). Old grudges are hard to keep through the chorus. Once a day.

AbilityDef.label: surgeon's sonata
AbilityDef.description: Play a slow, steady sonata for a doctor. For six hours their hands do not shake: their surgeries succeed 30% more often (relative to their own odds), and they tend wounds 20% better and 30% faster. Play it before the risky operation, not after. Twice a day.

AbilityDef.label: catchy tune
AbilityDef.description: Teach someone a tune they cannot stop humming. For a day they hum it wherever they go, and anyone who comes within 4 cells of them catches it (but does not pass it on). Hummer and listeners alike find their recreation draining 40% slower for a day. Send it round the colony with your busiest hauler or cook. Once a day.

li.flavor: It goes da-da-DEE-da. No, the other one.

AbilityDef.label: song on the wind
AbilityDef.description: Sing a song meant for someone you have never met, and let the wind carry it past the edge of the map. Someone out there hears it: a wanderer arrives soon after, asking to join the colony. Once a season.

li.flavor: Nobody walks the rim alone for long once they've heard that tune.

AbilityDef.label: taunting elegy
AbilityDef.description: Stand over a fallen body and sing its elegy, mockingly, for its friends to hear. Every enemy within 8 cells of the corpse is disheartened for 20 seconds (25% worse aim, 20% worse in melee, 15% slower), and each person among them has one chance in three to lose heart altogether and run from the battle. Bosses are unmoved. Bring their champion down first, then sing over him.

AbilityDef.label: battle hymn
AbilityDef.description: Sing a battle hymn as you fight: for fifteen seconds allies near you gain valor and enemies near you are battered by sound.

AbilityDef.label: thunderous chord
AbilityDef.description: Strike a chord so loud it knocks enemies off their feet.

AbilityDef.label: rallying cry
AbilityDef.description: A cry that snaps allies out of panic and breakdowns, heals them and steels their nerves.

AbilityDef.label: dirge
AbilityDef.description: A funeral song for enemies who aren't dead yet. They weaken and their doom approaches.

AbilityDef.label: song of ragnarok
AbilityDef.description: The end-of-the-world song. Allies become legends - valor, haste, power and wards - while enemies are shattered by sound.

AbilityDef.label: song of the undying
AbilityDef.description: A saga so stirring that death itself waits for the last verse. For thirty seconds, allies around you who fall are pulled back to life.

AbilityDef.label: named in the saga
AbilityDef.description: Name an enemy in your saga. For 30 seconds it takes 30% more damage from everything. If it dies while its name still rings, its death becomes a verse: every ally within 12 cells of the body gains valor, every colonist among them remembers being there (+6 mood for three days), and you regain 20 mana.

li.flavor: 'And then came Bjorn, whose axe was hungry...'

AbilityDef.label: horn of the hall
AbilityDef.description: Blow the great horn. Everyone of the colony on the map (and any guests) drops what they are doing, even sleep, and hurries to you at double speed for 20 seconds; getting hurt breaks the call. For two hours after, their tiredness stops growing and they walk 10% faster, and they wake with 20% more rest. Draft them as they arrive. Prisoners cannot leave their cells; the colony's animals come running too. Once a day.

li.flavor: Three blasts: raiders. Nobody remembers what four blasts means.

AbilityDef.label: saga of the old ones
AbilityDef.description: Recite the saga of the old ones, who built the great machines before the fall. Somewhere in its four hundred verses is something your researchers did not know: 400 research points (more with spell power) go into the current project, and a project with fewer than 150 points left is finished outright. Once a day.

AbilityDef.label: charm
AbilityDef.description: Charm a single enemy into fighting for you for thirty seconds.

AbilityDef.label: mesmerize
AbilityDef.description: A dazzling display of light and color. Enemies in the area stand transfixed.

AbilityDef.label: mirage
AbilityDef.description: Fold light around yourself. You vanish, and allies nearby become harder to hit.

AbilityDef.label: silver tongue
AbilityDef.description: Talk a prisoner, a downed enemy or a visitor into joining the colony on the spot.

AbilityDef.label: mass domination
AbilityDef.description: Bend every lesser mind in an area to your will for a full minute. Bosses resist.

AbilityDef.label: plagiarize
AbilityDef.description: Reach into someone's mind and take what they know. A large chunk of their best skill's experience becomes yours.

AbilityDef.label: phantom feast
AbilityDef.description: Lay an illusory banquet before everyone within 6 cells of the target. Nobody is fed, but everyone believes they have eaten a lavish meal: they get the mood of one (as from a real lavish meal) and for a day their hunger grows half as fast. The illusion that gets a colony through the last week of winter. Once a day.

AbilityDef.label: hypnotherapy
AbilityDef.description: Put a colonist into a trance and talk them out of their cravings. Every addiction they have is gone at once, withdrawal and all (even luciferium), and they come out of it calm and clear-headed (+5 mood for two days). It cannot stop them from starting again. Once every five days.

AbilityDef.label: false sun
AbilityDef.description: Hang an illusion of the noonday sun in the air for three days. It is so convincing that the plants believe it: it lights the ground like a sun lamp, so crops within about 6 cells grow indoors, underground or through an eclipse (in the daytime hours; plants still rest at night), and nobody near it works in the dark. It needs no power and burns no fuel. Once every three days.

AbilityDef.label: pie in the face
AbilityDef.description: Conjure and throw a custard pie. Humiliating, blinding and mildly concussive.

AbilityDef.label: wild magic
AbilityDef.description: Something happens! Each target nearby suffers - or enjoys - a random magical effect.

AbilityDef.label: lucky coin
AbilityDef.description: Flip an ally a lucky coin. Heads: they crit more and dodge better. Tails: also that.

AbilityDef.label: confetti cannon
AbilityDef.description: A deafening cannon of confetti. Enemies in front are stunned and concussed; it is very festive.

AbilityDef.label: grand finale
AbilityDef.description: The show-stopper. Twenty random magical effects explode over a huge area. Nobody, including the jester, knows what will happen.

AbilityDef.label: banana peels
AbilityDef.description: Scatter conjured banana peels across an area. For fifteen seconds, enemies who walk through keep slipping over.

AbilityDef.label: juggling knives
AbilityDef.description: Juggle three knives around yourself at alarming speed. Anyone who gets close gets cut, and occasionally a custard pie flies out of the act.

AbilityDef.label: pass the hat
AbilityDef.description: Juggle, tumble and fall over for everyone within 9 cells, then pass the hat. Every visitor, trader and guest of a friendly faction watching tosses in 10 to 25 silver (5% more per level of your Social skill), regains 20% recreation and leaves their faction a little fonder of the colony (+1 goodwill per guest, at most +5 per faction). Colonists just enjoy the show (+10% recreation). The silver lands at your feet. Twice a day.

AbilityDef.label: wheel of fortune
AbilityDef.description: Spin the jester's wheel and let fate pick something to happen to the colony. Most slices are good: cargo pods, a falling ship chunk, a meteorite full of ore, a wild animal deciding to join you, a psychic soothe, an ambrosia sprout or a refugee pod. Some are not: a short circuit, a solar flare, an eclipse or a family of alphabeavers. Slices that cannot happen right now are skipped. Once every three days.

AbilityDef.label: seltzer bottle
AbilityDef.description: Spray a fizzing blast of conjured soda water in a 50-degree cone 7 cells long. Every fire it touches goes out (on the ground, on buildings and on anyone burning, friend or foe), and enemies caught in it are knocked back 2 cells and left sputtering for 10 seconds (15% slower, 20% worse aim). Put out the kitchen, then the raiders.

li.flavor: The oldest trick in the book. The book is very wet.

li.label: enjoyed a joyful tune
li.description: That song was wonderful. I can't get it out of my head.

HediffDef.label: song of the undying
HediffDef.description: Death waits for the song to end. If this person dies while it plays, they rise again.

HediffDef.label: festive
HediffDef.description: In a festive mood: recreation fills half again as fast.

li.label: sang together
li.description: We sang the same song around the fire. It's hard to stay cross with someone after that.

li.label: sang in a small group
li.description: A few of us sang together. It was nice.

li.label: sang in a choir
li.description: We sang together, all of us at once. I still feel it.

li.label: sang in a big choir
li.description: So many voices in one song. I felt like part of something.

li.label: sang in a great choir
li.description: The whole colony sang as one. I'll remember that night for a long time.

HediffDef.label: surgeon's sonata
HediffDef.description: A slow, steady sonata keeps this doctor's hands from shaking.

HediffDef.label: humming a catchy tune
HediffDef.description: Humming a tune that will not leave. Anyone who comes close catches it too, and recreation drains slower.

HediffDef.label: catchy tune
HediffDef.description: Caught a catchy tune from someone humming it. Recreation drains slower.

HediffDef.label: disheartened
HediffDef.description: Heard their fallen comrade mocked in song. The fight has gone out of them.

HediffDef.label: nightsong
HediffDef.description: Sleeping near a bard who hums in their sleep. Rest comes faster.

HediffDef.label: named in the saga
HediffDef.description: Named in a skald's saga. Every blow lands harder, and its death will be sung.

li.label: a verse for the saga
li.description: I was there when the one named in the skald's saga fell. They will sing of it for years.

HediffDef.label: answering the horn
HediffDef.description: The great horn is calling. Hurrying to the skald.

HediffDef.label: roused by the horn
HediffDef.description: Woken by the horn and ready for anything. Tiredness can wait.

HediffDef.label: frith
HediffDef.description: Under the skald's frith: peace among kin. No fights here.

HediffDef.label: phantom feast
HediffDef.description: Convinced by an illusion that they ate a banquet. Hunger grows half as fast.

li.label: free of cravings
li.description: The illusionist talked me out of it while I was under. The craving is just... gone.

ThingDef.label: false sun
ThingDef.description: An illusion of the noonday sun, hung in the air by an illusionist. It is so convincing that plants grow under it as if under a sun lamp, and it needs no power at all.

HediffDef.label: soaked
HediffDef.description: Drenched in conjured soda water. Sputtering, sticky and slow.

li.label: the jester made me laugh
li.description: I couldn't help it. That jester is ridiculous.
